body: a mecha-hawk coastal scout-mount, full side-profile view, wings spread wide as if gliding, talons extended below, an empty rider saddle-perch mounted between the wing-roots (no rider), a sleek armored head with a sharp beak and one visible glass-lens eye. Sea-glass teal #4ec9d0 feather-plates layered like real feathers (each plate a distinct overlapping shape, not a smooth shell), sun-bleached sand #f4c8a0 underbelly plating, cyan #5fe0ff glowing accent lines along the wing-strut edges like bioluminescent veins, brushed-steel talons. TURTLE'S NOTE: the wings should read as genuinely aerodynamic -- real primary-feather layering at the wingtips, not a solid decorative fan -- this is a working coastal patrol scout, built to actually fly reconnaissance over the water, not a trophy piece. Cinematic occult-almanac quality render, bright coastal daylight with a soft cyan rim-light, plain flat sky-grey background so the silhouette reads clearly, full body visible beak to tail with wings fully spread, no text, no logos, no rider, no watermark
